products.analytical_basis: as-sold named Mango Chutney; product-specific sample basis to confirm
products.condition: The actual product, not merely an ingredient, must be Mango Chutney under §2.3.42: sound Mangifera indica processed and cooked with nutritive sweeteners; the FSSR requires at least 50% total soluble solids, at least 40% fruit, and pH not exceeding 4.6. General mixed chutney under §2.3.41 is not the named contaminant article.
required_evidence: Finished lot and label prove Mango Chutney under FSSR §2.3.42 (not generic mixed fruit/vegetable chutney)
Mango identity, recipe, cooking, 50% minimum soluble solids, 40% minimum fruit, pH <=4.6 and pack records
Finished-product lead and tin sampling/method/analytical basis and operative amendments
Other contaminant, pesticide, microbiological, packaging and labelling obligations separately assessed
Actual batch-specific laboratory results before issuing any sample or regulatory PASS
negative_controls: Recipe with mango ingredient but no §2.3.42 finished-article verification
Transfer of pulp/juice metal or fresh fruit MRL to finished chutney
Automatic laboratory or whole-product compliance PASS

products.qualified_form: Dry curry powder or mix masala
products.qualified_fssr: 2.9.31; must independently meet named dry curry powder / mix masala finished form
products.article: Dehydrated onions, dried herbs and spices, curry powder and mix masalas, flavourings, alginic acid, alignates, agar, carrageen and similar products derived from seaweed
products.analytical_basis: dry matter basis; not FSSR acid-insoluble ash result
products.condition: The finished seasoning must itself be dry curry powder or mix masala, verified by its recipe and process. FSSR §2.9.31 includes wet pastes, vegetable/protein/dairy/sugar mixtures and other seasonings; generic seasoning cannot inherit this named dry spice-mix lead article.
required_evidence: Actual marketed finished product matches named dry curry powder or mix masala and not generic seasoning §2.9.31
Documented spices, herbs, other formula ingredients, dry milling and moisture/process conditions
Laboratory lead result on a dry-matter basis, not a total ash or HCl-insoluble ash basis
Current CTR/FSSR amendments and other applicable contaminant/residue articles independently reviewed
Real lot records and complete assessment before any numeric application or compliance PASS
negative_controls: Wet seasoning, tomato/ginger/garlic paste or sauce
Mixed seasoning with yeast/protein, dairy or sweeteners but no finished dry-mix-masala identity
Ingredient-level spice limit transferred to an unidentified composite
Dry matter confused with total ash or acid-insoluble ash
Automatic laboratory or full-product compliance PASS
